title: Kestrel Auto Finance Credit Policy — Down Payment Points for Premium Vehicles on Vehicle Purchase Agreements
content:
**Rule.** On an order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements financed through Kestrel Auto Finance, the down payment percentage rises for a premium vehicle financed below Tier A. The points are added to the tier's minimum down payment percentage, and the required down payment is worked from the resulting percentage. The tier is that of the order's approved contract in Kestrel Auto Finance Retail Installment Contracts; the vehicle program is the program of the order.

| Vehicle program | Tier of the approved contract | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified | Kestrel Finance Tier C, Tier D or Tier E | 5.0 (the premium low-tier points) |
| Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified | Kestrel Finance Tier B | 2.0 (the premium mid-tier points) |
| Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified | Kestrel Finance Tier A or Tier A+ | none |
| any other vehicle program | any tier | none |

**Worked example (hypothetical; a tier minimum of 15 percent is an illustrative input).** A Kestrel Factory Certified vehicle charged at $45000.00 and financed at Tier D: 15 percent plus 5.0 points is 20 percent, and 20 percent of $45000.00 is $9000.00. The same vehicle at Tier B with a hypothetical 10 percent minimum: 12 percent, $5400.00. A Kestrel Certified Plus vehicle at Tier D: no points.
